agents.name: Spec-writer
agents.description: Turns a feature, bug, or resolved doubt into a Given/When/Then test plan.

agents.name: Test-implementer
agents.description: Takes the plan and writes the actual Playwright spec and Page Object code.

agents.name: Code-reviewer
agents.description: Checks new tests against the house style rules; fixes the mechanical, escalates the rest.

agents.name: Triage
agents.description: Reads a failed test and classifies it: brittleness, real bug, recommendation, or doubt.

agents.name: Self-healer
agents.description: Repairs a broken locator, only within the defined fallback chain, never a guess.

agents.name: Doc-keeper
agents.description: The only agent that writes to the bugs, doubts, recommendations, and lessons records.
